notes: kb/Work PB231 (the POINTER third, 2026-09-05) CLOSES this row: GR4a and GR4b are now observed over a record carrying EVERY leaf kind this compiler admits, the pointer-class one included, and observed to be the SAME storage. conformance:cases/14.9.3-ALLOCATE/pb231_based_pointer_leaf ALLOCATEs 01 P USAGE POINTER BASED RETURNING WS-A (GR4a) and writes through P's own implicit pointer (GR4b), then proves the two addresses are one storage rather than two copies in a way the byte-window goldens cannot: a SECOND based pointer item Q is pointed at the same address, reads P's value back through it (ALIAS=[ABCD]), and SETTING Q TO NULL is then visible through P (SHARED=YES). That is the assertion that the managed slot belongs to the storage AREA and not to the item - which is what GR4a/GR4b together mean for a pointer-class member, and what a per-item field could not have satisfied. There is no remaining leaf kind: the byte-window carriage gate is empty.
